name: Cocoon Media Management
description: Integrates the Cocoon (use-cocoon.nl) DAM so editors can browse and import remote assets into the Drupal media library.
project_description:
This module is the official user friendly Drupal module for integration with SaaS Media Management Software – Cocoon (use-cocoon.nl).

This plugin sends / requests the stored media from the Cocoon web service and gets the corresponding media for easy usage in Drupal. No personal data or any other information are sent to the web service. 

 Save & share media files in the cloud

Cocoon is easy-to-use Digital Asset Management software for marketing and communication professionals. Manage your precious media files in a central location in the cloud and keep control over your brand identity
